reference.title: The screens of the app
reference.shortdesc: What each place in the bar along the bottom shows, and what the More list holds, with a picture of each screen.

section.title: The bar along the bottom
section.p: The bar stays at the bottom of every screen. It has five places. Some show your whole tree. Others show one person, the person named in the chip that starts with . The chip is empty until you open someone.

table.title: The places in the bar and what they show

row.entry: Your family trees, one card for each.
A drawing of the person with parents, partners and children.
The things that happened in that person's life.
A list of other places, such as the notes about a person and the colours.

section.p: The search box and the button are along the top of every screen. A back arrow at the top left takes you back one screen.
section.note: If a page says Select a person or No person selected, it needs a person first. Search for someone, then open them. shows how.

section.p: This is the first screen. Each card is one family tree. It tells you how many people, families and events the tree holds. starts here.
This is one person's page: their names, their birth and death, their family and their photos. shows how to open it.

section.p: Choose to see six places. Each one opens a screen of its own.
